en.headline: Hong Kong men’s foil team reach Asian Games final after beating Korea
en.dek: Ryan Choi, Cheung Ka-long, Harris Ho and Leung Chin-yu defeated South Korea 45-41 in the semi-finals in Nagoya and will face Japan for gold.
body: Hong Kong’s men’s foil team reached the Asian Games final on Friday after a 45-41 semi-final victory over South Korea at the Aichi Sky Expo in Nagoya.

The side, featuring Olympic champion Cheung Ka-long, world championship medallist Ryan Choi, Harris Ho and Leung Chin-yu, built an early lead. Choi took five consecutive points in one bout to stretch the advantage to 10-2. Hong Kong maintained a comfortable margin for most of the contest before Korea mounted a late challenge.

Choi, fencing with a hand injury that required pain relief, held firm in the final bout as the score closed to 41-43 against Hong Kong. He then scored the decisive touches to secure the 45-41 win. The team is assured of at least a silver medal and will meet host nation Japan in the gold-medal match.

The result follows earlier wins over India and Uzbekistan that had already guaranteed a podium place. It is the second consecutive Asian Games final appearance for the Hong Kong men’s foil team after the 2018 Games in Jakarta.

zh.headline: 港隊男花團體擊敗韓國晉決賽 與日本爭亞運金牌
zh.dek: 蔡俊彥、張家朗、何承謙及梁千雨周五在名古屋以45：41擊敗南韓晉身決賽，至少穩奪銀牌，稍後對日本爭金。
body: 香港男子花劍隊周五在名古屋亞運團體賽四強以45：41擊敗南韓，晉身決賽，將與東道主日本爭奪金牌。
港隊由奧運冠軍張家朗、世錦賽獎牌得主蔡俊彥、何承謙及梁千雨組成。比賽初段蔡俊彥連取五分，將比分拉開至10：2，港隊其後一直保持領先約十分優勢。
尾段南韓追近，蔡俊彥手部有傷需噴止痛劑，一度被追至41：43落後，其後連取兩分協助港隊以45：41勝出，至少穩奪銀牌。
港隊早前已先後擊敗印度及烏茲別克晉級，確定獎牌。這是港隊繼2018年雅加達亞運後再度殺入男子花劍團體決賽。
